findings.claim: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate proxy is non-monotone over the full observed score window [0.0,0.49]: it rises to a positive peak near the middle of the window, then falls to a negative trough, then partially recovers, with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches.

The endpoint rates of landmark_00_local_dx are strongly signed and opposite: first_rate_z is strongly negative and last_rate_z is strongly positive, so the late-window local slope is positive while the early-window slope is negative.

The whole-window mean of landmark_00_local_dx is near zero (whole_window_z small and negative), so the window-integrated level does not distinguish this coordinate; only the within-window contrast does.

A degree-2 polynomial is not accepted for landmark_00_local_dx (polynomial_accepted false, relative_node_RMSE large, held-out batch MSE not improved by higher degree), so a stationary quadratic target is not supported by this curve.

The learning window and observed score times are [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior; label semantics are therefore not decoded affinity.

hypotheses.direction: reward the late-window positive local slope and the early-window negative slope as a contrast, not an absolute coordinate target
hypotheses.falsifier: If the compiled reward table leaves landmark_00_local_dx trace unchanged, or if the late-window rate sign does not remain positive under the registered recipe, the contrast hypothesis fails.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx (predicted endpoint world-A local x-displacement proxy)
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score window [0.0,0.49]; no extrapolation beyond 0.49
hypotheses.statement: A time-dependent reward contrast on landmark_00_local_dx, tracking the observed early-negative to late-positive rate reversal rather than a fixed level, is a supported coordinate candidate for the reward lane.

hypotheses.direction: contrast/derivative-based reward, not absolute coordinate targeting
hypotheses.falsifier: If a stationary absolute target on landmark_00_local_dx reproduces the observed contrast without a time-varying term, this hypothesis is not needed.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx whole-window level and node-wise contrast
hypotheses.statement: Because the whole-window mean of landmark_00_local_dx is near zero and the polynomial fit is rejected, any reward edit should be expressed as a within-window contrast or its time derivative rather than a stationary absolute target on this coordinate.

limitations: Only one curve (landmark_00_local_dx) was read; other landmark coordinates and soft_mass features were not inspected, so cross-coordinate consistency is unverified.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; no stage boundary or phase knot is supported by data.
The curve is a predicted endpoint world-A coordinate proxy; no physical energy, chemical interaction or neural-module interpretation is attached.
Selection preference is association only; no descendant survival or decoded final affinity evidence was delivered, and missing decoded labels are unobserved rather than failures.
No current study quality outcomes are available to the role, so no claim of measured final benefit is made.
